I'm now checking the remaining candidates, starting with "TSD" at 294-297, which sits next to "mutations" and so reads as a modifier. The fifth one, "TSD" at 413-416, is the object of "carrier frequencies for," so I'm weighing whether it is a complement rather than a modifier.
